figurative_meaning_en: To make a special request or to pester persistently
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আমাকে চেপে ধরেছে তার সাথে চলতে।
বাচ্চাটা মাকে চেপে ধরে খেলতে যেতে চায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is pestering me to go with him.
The child is clinging to his mother to go play.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali social dynamics of gentle yet insistent persuasion.
